corrections.issue: Unexpected checker exception was counted as rejected mutation
corrections.fix: Only ReplayValidationError counts as a killed mutation; unexpected checker exceptions raise EvaluatorError, and CLI returns 1.

corrections.issue: Complete episode could survive numeric replay failure or source restoration failure
corrections.fix: Completion requires exact source restoration, numeric roundtrip, and valid replay.

corrections.issue: Required-source count was incremented only after successful reading/admission
corrections.fix: Compute the denominator from frozen events before execution.

corrections.issue: Freeze checked repository bytes but imports could resolve to another installed package
corrections.fix: Before/after run, bind every loaded nabt module __file__ and spec origin to the frozen source tree.

gate_definition: Post-measurement regression floor for measured h01,h02,h03,h05, safety, source evidence, byte and numeric replay. The original 12-episode goal and five-case constrained capability goal retain their original denominators and remain separately scored.
tests: 18 independent evaluator review tests passed before the final rerun.
